title: Dark Souls… but you only tap and swipe
author: Square-Yam-3772
selftext:
It’s a side-scrolling prototype where you auto-run, tap to attack, and swipe to dodge.

I’m trying to keep the “commitment” feel (no mid-attack turning, punishable dodges, etc).

Does this feel readable to you?

comments.author: CosmicDystopia
comments.body: I'm intrigued. I'd be interested in a playable demo.

comments.author: sharkymcstevenson2
comments.body: Dude I love the backgrounds, how did you get it like that and what did you use to make them?

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body: everything is just nano banana pro except the 3d meshes

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: Awesome, how were you able to get the foreground and background depth going? Could have never guessed it was nano, guessing you layered them? Any workflow tips to achieve the same effect would be greatly appreciated!

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
before I start implementation, I had a chat with the AIs so I have a plan before I generate the assets. 

I don't have unity mcp working, so I still have to manually arrange the scene. 

I think the depth you are referring to is the just the blurring effect. 

maybe I will do a behind-the-scene video. those posts tend to get a lot of upvotes

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body: A video would be great! I want to do the same background effect
